data.title: Unit 1 : The Human Body
Brain, Heart and Lungs
data.heading: The brain
data.text: The brain controls all the body functions.
The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain.
The cerebrum is divided into two parts, left side and right side.
The right side of the cerebrum helps in things like colours, music, and shapes.
The left side of the cerebrum helps in maths, science, words, and language.
The right side of your brain controls the left side of the body.
The left side of the brain controls the right side of the body.
